description: This file contains utility functions and templates for applying pointwise operations to tensors on CPU, including iteration over tensor elements, stride sorting, and multi-tensor apply functions.

classes.name: strided_tensor_iter_fixed
classes.description: Template class for iterating over fixed-size strided tensors with unrolled loops for performance.

classes.name: strided_tensor_iter
classes.description: Template class for iterating over tensors with dynamic size and stride information.

methods.name: sort_strides
methods.description: Reorders tensor dimensions based on strides to optimize memory access patterns.

methods.name: CPU_tensor_apply2
methods.description: Applies a binary pointwise operation to two tensors.

methods.name: CPU_tensor_apply3
methods.description: Applies a ternary pointwise operation to three tensors.

methods.name: CPU_tensor_apply4
methods.description: Applies a quaternary pointwise operation to four tensors.
